rationale: Option A's HostLayout.normalize seam is batch/backfill-only and never consumed by extract_user_messages/_compute_cache_rate_from_jsonl, so it cannot deliver the AC's live-watch requirement; Option B matches the issue's own seam-is-refused-on-content design and has SessionEvent/generator precedent in LLEvent and the gemini/omp normalizers.
rule: Option B: standalone session-watcher interface (detect_session/watch/stop, SessionEvent, parse_codex_rollout)
alternatives_rejected: Option A: extend HostLayout.normalize/normalize_file with a Codex entry
